issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{は/が|wa-topic}サッカー{が/を|ga-stative}好[す]きです。
issues.problem: を with 好き is colloquial, not standard; it should not be taught as an equally good answer.
issues.action: Removed を alternative; slot is {が|ga-stative}.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{は/が|wa-topic}肉[にく]{も|mo-both}魚[さかな]{も|mo-both}好[す]きです。
issues.problem: Distractor と gives 肉と魚も好きです, grammatical and close in meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor と with が.

issues.jp_before: ほら、そこ{に|ni-location}猫[ねこ]{が|ga-existence}います{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: English 'over there' corresponds to あそこ, not そこ.
issues.action: English changed to 'Look, there's a cat right there!'.

issues.jp_before: 妹[いもうと]{は|wa-topic}来年[らいねん]十歳[じゅっさい]{に/と|ni-change}なります。
issues.problem: となる is literary/formal and not equally natural in this everyday sentence.
issues.action: Removed と alternative; slot is {に|ni-change}.

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}寒[さむ]い{から/ので|kara-because}、コート{を|o-object}着[き]ます。
issues.problem: Distractor と (寒いと、コートを着ます 'when it is cold I wear a coat') is grammatical and near the intended meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor と with を.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{に|ni-recipient}手紙[てがみ]{を|o-object}書[か]きました。
issues.problem: 友達へ手紙を書きました is equally natural; alternative missing.
